name: Metamorphosis
overview: Scripture reveals metamorphosis as a profound spiritual transformation initiated by repentance and turning to God, who is gracious and merciful. Jesus' call to repent signals the nearness of God's kingdom, inviting believers to a renewed life marked by cleansing and renewal. This change is further affirmed through baptism and the reception of the Holy Spirit, promising the believer a continual source of eternal life and spiritual refreshment from the Lord's presence.
